text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One is definitely going to take this 
Takarazuka Kinen! She's sure to run an 
amazing race just like in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
But this time Yaeno Muteki is running, and 
there's also Sakura Chiyono O, so I don't 
think it's that easy to call~

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"This Takarazuka Kinen will decide it. 
Where Inari One stands in a race without 
Oguri Cap...!"

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Don't get buried here... Let me see your 
potential, make a believer out of me...!"

text_block_list.name: Downtown Folks
text_block_list.text:
Hoo-ray! Hoo-ray! Inari One! Go, go, Inari 
Oneee!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Guess this is what you expect from the 
grand finale of the first half of the 
year. Nothin' but huge auras 
everywhere—it's suffocatin', dammit.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(—Makes sense, honestly. Every single one 
of you's got feelings just like mine—a 
drive that refuses to lose.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Still, though. That doesn't mean I'm 
gonna just give away the win. What I'm 
after are real, tangible results!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If I can't beat everyone here, I ain't 
ever gonna become Umamusume of the 
Year...!
